main_text.p: VII. Finis (inquit Aristot. lib.1. Politi. cap. 9.) in infinitum expetitur, media non in infinitum, sed quantum satis est ad finem acquirendum; itaque Finis est mensura mediorum, idque non solum in ratione quantitatis, sed etiam in ratione qualitatis sive bonitatis; ut enim finis per se bonus est, ita media eatenus bona sunt, quatenus conducunt ad finem consequendum, & quae ad finem consequendum plus conferunt, meliora sunt aliis: quod adeo verum est, ut etiam media quaedam sua natura mala, amentur tamen & expetantur ut bona, & sint etiam revera bona, quatenus conducunt ad obtinendum finem: si tamen media inhonesta sint, nullius finis gratia expetenda sunt, quia quod inhonestum est sua natura, nullius respectu bonum esse potest.

VIII. Finis solet dividi in finem cujus & finem cui. Finis cujus dicitur, quem efficiens expetit: Finis cui, in cujus gratiam sive commodum finis cujus expetitur. Ex.gr. Medicinae finis cujus, est sanitas; Cui, aeger: Finis cujus, movet efficientem amore concupiscentiae; Finis cui, amore benevolentiae: Finis cujus vel est operatio, vel opus aliquod praeter operationem, aut usus operis; sic finis Musicae est, perite canere, finis virtutis, εὐπραξία[?]; at artium mechanicarum finis, non tam est operari, quam opus aliquod, puta do-

page.notes: Printed text is in roman type with the Greek word εὐπραξία; its accent and breathing are hard to read in the scan, so the word is marked [?]. Handwritten or pencil marks are present in the text (slashes after "finis" and near "non tam", a bracket near "domum") and are not transcribed. The line "mum," at the foot is the catchword and is given under bottom_margin. The small marks at the bottom left and the Google watermark at the bottom right are not printed text and are left out. The first paragraph's "Politi." is read from "Po-" with the hyphen at the line end and the rest of the word unclear; "Politi." is the reading for "Politic." as printed in the lib. reference, so it is marked here as a plain reading and should be checked against the scan at higher resolution.
